text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Undergraduate school transcript 5.Two Recommendation letters From Professors, associate professors or equivalents. 6.Certificate of HSK Band 6 or above (Not needed for English taught courses)
